verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses
verses.literalPt: FALOU mais o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

verses.original: עֲשֵׂ֣ה לְךָ֗ שְׁתֵּי֙ חֲצֽוֹצְרֹ֣ת כֶּ֔סֶף מִקְשָׁ֖ה תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֑ם וְהָי֤וּ לְךָ֙ לְמִקְרָ֣א הָֽעֵדָ֔ה וּלְמַסַּ֖ע אֶת־ הַֽמַּחֲנֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·śêh lə·ḵā šə·tê ḥă·ṣō·wṣ·rōṯ ke·sep̄ miq·šāh ta·‘ă·śeh ’ō·ṯām wə·hā·yū lə·ḵā lə·miq·rā hā·‘ê·ḏāh ū·lə·mas·sa‘ ’eṯ- ham·ma·ḥă·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: Make two trumpets of hammered silver . . . to be used for calling the congregation and for having the camps set out
verses.literalPt: Faze-te duas trombetas de prata; de obra batida as farás, e elas te servirão para a convocação da congregação, e para a partida dos arraiais.

verses.original: וְתָקְע֖וּ בָּהֵ֑ן וְנֽוֹעֲד֤וּ אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ כָּל־ הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה אֶל־ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṯā·qə·‘ū bā·hên wə·nō·w·‘ă·ḏū ’ê·le·ḵā kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh ’el- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: When both are sounded the whole congregation is to assemble before you at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting
verses.literalPt: E, quando as tocarem, então toda a congregação se reunirá a ti à porta da tenda da congregação.

verses.original: וְאִם־ בְּאַחַ֖ת יִתְקָ֑עוּ וְנוֹעֲד֤וּ אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ הַנְּשִׂיאִ֔ים רָאשֵׁ֖י אַלְפֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- bə·’a·ḥaṯ yiṯ·qā·‘ū wə·nō·w·‘ă·ḏū ’ê·le·ḵā han·nə·śî·’îm rā·šê ’al·p̄ê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: But if only one is sounded then the leaders the heads of the clans of Israel are to gather before you
verses.literalPt: Mas, quando tocar uma só, então a ti se congregarão os príncipes, os cabeças dos milhares de Israel.

verses.original: וּתְקַעְתֶּ֖ם תְּרוּעָ֑ה וְנָֽסְעוּ֙ הַֽמַּחֲנ֔וֹת הַחֹנִ֖ים קֵֽדְמָה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ṯə·qa‘·tem tə·rū·‘āh wə·nā·sə·‘ū ham·ma·ḥă·nō·wṯ ha·ḥō·nîm qê·ḏə·māh
verses.literal: When you sound short blasts the camps that lie on the east side are to set out
verses.literalPt: Quando, retinindo, as tocardes, então partirão os arraiais que estão acampados do lado do oriente.

verses.original: וּתְקַעְתֶּ֤ם תְּרוּעָה֙ שֵׁנִ֔ית וְנָֽסְעוּ֙ הַֽמַּחֲנ֔וֹת הַחֹנִ֖ים תֵּימָ֑נָה תְּרוּעָ֥ה יִתְקְע֖וּ לְמַסְעֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ṯə·qa‘·tem tə·rū·‘āh šê·nîṯ wə·nā·sə·‘ū ham·ma·ḥă·nō·wṯ ha·ḥō·nîm tê·mā·nāh tə·rū·‘āh yiṯ·qə·‘ū lə·mas·‘ê·hem
verses.literal: When you sound the short blasts a second time the camps that lie on the south side are to set out The blasts are to signal them to set out
verses.literalPt: Mas, quando a segunda vez retinindo, as tocardes, então partirão os arraiais que estão acampados do lado do sul; retinindo, as tocarão para as suas partidas.

verses.original: וּבְהַקְהִ֖יל אֶת־ הַקָּהָ֑ל תִּתְקְע֖וּ וְלֹ֥א תָרִֽיעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·haq·hîl ’eṯ- haq·qā·hāl tiṯ·qə·‘ū wə·lō ṯā·rî·‘ū
verses.literal: To convene the assembly you are to sound long blasts not short ones
verses.literalPt: Porém, ajuntando a congregação, as tocareis; mas sem retinir.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֤י אַהֲרֹן֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים יִתְקְע֖וּ בַּֽחֲצֹצְר֑וֹת וְהָי֥וּ לָכֶ֛ם לְחֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê ’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hă·nîm yiṯ·qə·‘ū ba·ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rō·wṯ wə·hā·yū lā·ḵem lə·ḥuq·qaṯ ‘ō·w·lām lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: The sons of Aaron the priests are to sound the trumpets This shall be a permanent statute for you and the generations to come
verses.literalPt: E os filhos de Arão, sacerdotes, tocarão as trombetas; e a vós serão por estatuto perpétuo nas vossas gerações.

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ תָבֹ֨אוּ מִלְחָמָ֜ה בְּאַרְצְכֶ֗ם עַל־ הַצַּר֙ הַצֹּרֵ֣ר אֶתְכֶ֔ם וַהֲרֵעֹתֶ֖ם בַּחֲצֹצְר֑וֹת וֲנִזְכַּרְתֶּ֗ם לִפְנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם וְנוֹשַׁעְתֶּ֖ם מֵאֹיְבֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- ṯā·ḇō·’ū mil·ḥā·māh bə·’ar·ṣə·ḵem ‘al- haṣ·ṣar haṣ·ṣō·rêr ’eṯ·ḵem wa·hă·rê·‘ō·ṯem ba·ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rō·wṯ wă·niz·kar·tɛm lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem wə·nō·wō·ša‘·tem mê·’ō·yə·ḇê·ḵem
verses.literal: When you enter into battle in your land against an adversary who attacks you sound short blasts on the trumpets and you will be remembered before the LORD your God and saved from your enemies
verses.literalPt: E, quando na vossa terra sairdes a pelejar contra o inimigo, que vos oprime, também tocareis as trombetas retinindo, e perante o SENHOR vosso Deus haverá lembrança de vós, e sereis salvos de vossos inimigos.

verses.original: וּבְי֨וֹם שִׂמְחַתְכֶ֥ם וּֽבְמוֹעֲדֵיכֶם֮ וּבְרָאשֵׁ֣י חָדְשֵׁיכֶם֒ וּתְקַעְתֶּ֣ם בַּחֲצֹֽצְרֹ֗ת עַ֚ל עֹלֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְעַ֖ל זִבְחֵ֣י שַׁלְמֵיכֶ֑ם וְהָי֨וּ לָכֶ֤ם לְזִכָּרוֹן֙ לִפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·yō·wm śim·ḥaṯ·ḵem ū·ḇə·mō·w·‘ă·ḏê·ḵem ū·ḇə·rā·šê ḥā·ḏə·šê·ḵem ū·ṯə·qa‘·tem ba·ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rōṯ ‘al ‘ō·lō·ṯê·ḵem wə·‘al ziḇ·ḥê šal·mê·ḵem wə·hā·yū lā·ḵem lə·zik·kā·rō·wn lip̄·nê ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: And on your joyous occasions your appointed feasts and the beginning of each month you are to blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings . . . and peace offerings to serve as a reminder for you before your God I am the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Semelhantemente, no dia da vossa alegria e nas vossas solenidades, e nos princípios de vossos meses, também tocareis as trombetas sobre os vossos holocaustos, sobre os vossos sacrifícios pacíficos, e vos serão por memorial perante vosso Deus: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י בַּשָּׁנָ֧ה הַשֵּׁנִ֛ית בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֖י בְּעֶשְׂרִ֣ים בַּחֹ֑דֶשׁ נַעֲלָה֙ הֶֽעָנָ֔ן מֵעַ֖ל מִשְׁכַּ֥ן הָעֵדֻֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî baš·šā·nāh haš·šê·nîṯ ba·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šê·nî bə·‘eś·rîm ba·ḥō·ḏeš na·‘ă·lāh he·‘ā·nān mê·‘al miš·kan hā·‘ê·ḏuṯ
verses.literal: On the twentieth day of the second month of the second year the cloud was lifted from above the tabernacle of the Testimony
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu, no ano segundo, no segundo mês, aos vinte do mês, que a nuvem se alçou de sobre o tabernáculo da congregação.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֧וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לְמַסְעֵיהֶ֖ם מִמִּדְבַּ֣ר סִינָ֑י וַיִּשְׁכֹּ֥ן הֶעָנָ֖ן בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר פָּארָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl lə·mas·‘ê·hem mim·miḏ·bar sî·nāy way·yiš·kōn he·‘ā·nān bə·miḏ·bar pā·rān
verses.literal: and the Israelites . . . set out from the Wilderness of Sinai traveling from place to place until the cloud settled in the Wilderness of Paran
verses.literalPt: E os filhos de Israel, segundo a ordem de marcha, partiram do deserto de Sinai; e a nuvem parou no deserto de Parã.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ בָּרִאשֹׁנָ֑ה עַל־ פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū bā·ri·šō·nāh ‘al- pî Yah·weh bə·yaḏ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: They set out this first time according to the LORD’s command through Moses
verses.literalPt: Assim partiram pela primeira vez segundo a ordem do SENHOR, por intermédio de Moisés.

verses.original: וַיִּסַּ֞ע דֶּ֣גֶל מַחֲנֵ֧ה בְנֵֽי־ יְהוּדָ֛ה בָּרִאשֹׁנָ֖ה לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְעַל־ צְבָא֔וֹ נַחְשׁ֖וֹן בֶּן־ עַמִּינָדָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·sa‘ de·ḡel ma·ḥă·nêh ḇə·nê- yə·hū·ḏāh bā·ri·šō·nāh lə·ṣiḇ·’ō·ṯām wə·‘al- ṣə·ḇā·’ōw naḥ·šō·wn ben- ‘am·mî·nā·ḏāḇ
verses.literal: First the divisions of the camp of Judah . . . set out under their standard with Nahshon son of Amminadab in command . . .
verses.literalPt: Porque primeiramente partiu a bandeira do arraial dos filhos de Judá segundo os seus exércitos; e sobre o seu exército estava Naassom, filho de Aminadabe.

verses.original: וְעַ֨ל־ צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י יִשָׂשכָ֑ר נְתַנְאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ צוּעָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- ṣə·ḇā maṭ·ṭêh bə·nê yi·śā·š·ḵār nə·ṯan·’êl ben- ṣū·‘ār
verses.literal: Nethanel son of Zuar was over the division of the tribe of Issachar
verses.literalPt: E sobre o exército da tribo dos filhos de Issacar, Natanael, filho de Zuar.

verses.original: וְעַ֨ל־ צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י זְבוּלֻ֑ן אֱלִיאָ֖ב בֶּן־ חֵלֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- ṣə·ḇā maṭ·ṭêh bə·nê zə·ḇū·lun ’ĕ·lî·’āḇ ben- ḥê·lō·wn
verses.literal: and Eliab son of Helon was over the division of the tribe of Zebulun
verses.literalPt: E sobre o exército da tribo dos filhos de Zebulom, Eliabe, filho de Helom.

verses.original: וְהוּרַ֖ד הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן וְנָסְע֤וּ בְנֵֽי־ גֵרְשׁוֹן֙ וּבְנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֔י נֹשְׂאֵ֖י הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hū·raḏ ham·miš·kān wə·nā·sə·‘ū ḇə·nê- ḡê·rə·šō·wn ū·ḇə·nê mə·rā·rî nō·śə·’ê ham·miš·kān
verses.literal: Then the tabernacle was taken down and the Gershonites . . . and the Merarites . . . set out transporting it
verses.literalPt: Então desarmaram o tabernáculo, e os filhos de Gérson e os filhos de Merari partiram, levando o tabernáculo.

verses.original: וְנָסַ֗ע דֶּ֛גֶל מַחֲנֵ֥ה רְאוּבֵ֖ן לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְעַל־ צְבָא֔וֹ אֱלִיצ֖וּר בֶּן־ שְׁדֵיאֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·sa‘ de·ḡel ma·ḥă·nêh rə·’ū·ḇên lə·ṣiḇ·’ō·ṯām wə·‘al- ṣə·ḇā·’ōw ’ĕ·lî·ṣūr ben- šə·ḏê·’ūr
verses.literal: Then the divisions of the camp of Reuben set out under their standard with Elizur son of Shedeur in command . . .
verses.literalPt: Depois partiu a bandeira do arraial de Rúben segundo os seus exércitos; e sobre o seu exército estava Elizur, filho de Sedeur.

verses.original: וְעַ֨ל־ צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֑וֹן שְׁלֻֽמִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ צוּרִֽי שַׁדָּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- ṣə·ḇā maṭ·ṭêh bə·nê šim·‘ō·wn šə·lu·mî·’êl ben- ṣū·rî šad·dāy
verses.literal: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was over the division of the tribe of Simeon
verses.literalPt: E sobre o exército da tribo dos filhos de Simeão, Selumiel, filho de Zurisadai.

verses.original: וְעַל־ צְבָ֖א מַטֵּ֣ה בְנֵי־ גָ֑ד אֶלְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן־ דְּעוּאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- ṣə·ḇā maṭ·ṭêh ḇə·nê- ḡāḏ ’el·yā·sāp̄ ben- də·‘ū·’êl
verses.literal: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was over the division of the tribe of Gad . . .
verses.literalPt: E sobre o exército da tribo dos filhos de Gade, Eliasafe, filho de Deuel.

verses.original: וְנָסְעוּ֙ הַקְּהָתִ֔ים נֹשְׂאֵ֖י הַמִּקְדָּ֑שׁ וְהֵקִ֥ימוּ אֶת־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן עַד־ בֹּאָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·sə·‘ū haq·qə·hā·ṯîm nō·śə·’ê ham·miq·dāš wə·hê·qî·mū ’eṯ- ham·miš·kān ‘aḏ- bō·’ām
verses.literal: Then the Kohathites set out transporting the holy objects the tabernacle was to be set up before their arrival
verses.literalPt: Então partiram os coatitas, levando o santuário; e os outros levantaram o tabernáculo, enquanto estes vinham.

verses.original: וְנָסַ֗ע דֶּ֛גֶל מַחֲנֵ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ אֶפְרַ֖יִם לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְעַל־ צְבָא֔וֹ אֱלִישָׁמָ֖ע בֶּן־ עַמִּיהֽוּד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·sa‘ de·ḡel ma·ḥă·nêh ḇə·nê- ’ep̄·ra·yim lə·ṣiḇ·’ō·ṯām wə·‘al- ṣə·ḇā·’ōw ’ĕ·lî·šā·mā‘ ben- ‘am·mî·hūḏ
verses.literal: Next, the divisions of the camp of Ephraim . . . set out under their standard with Elishama son of Ammihud in command . . .
verses.literalPt: Depois partiu a bandeira do arraial dos filhos de Efraim segundo os seus exércitos; e sobre o seu exército estava Elisama, filho de Amiúde.

verses.original: וְעַ֨ל־ צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה גַּמְלִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ פְּדָה־ צֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- ṣə·ḇā maṭ·ṭêh bə·nê mə·naš·šeh gam·lî·’êl ben- pə·ḏāh- ṣūr
verses.literal: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur . . . was over the division of the tribe of Manasseh . . .
verses.literalPt: E sobre o exército da tribo dos filhos de Manassés, Gamaliel, filho de Pedazur.

verses.original: וְעַ֨ל־ צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן אֲבִידָ֖ן בֶּן־ גִּדְעוֹנִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- ṣə·ḇā maṭ·ṭêh bə·nê ḇin·yā·min ’ă·ḇî·ḏān ben- giḏ·‘ō·w·nî
verses.literal: and Abidan . . . son of Gideoni was over the division of the tribe of Benjamin
verses.literalPt: E sobre o exército da tribo dos filhos de Benjamim, Abidã, filho de Gideoni.

verses.original: וְנָסַ֗ע דֶּ֚גֶל מַחֲנֵ֣ה בְנֵי־ דָ֔ן מְאַסֵּ֥ף לְכָל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֹ֖ת לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְעַל־ צְבָא֔וֹ אֲחִיעֶ֖זֶר בֶּן־ עַמִּישַׁדָּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·sa‘ de·ḡel ma·ḥă·nêh ḇə·nê- ḏān mə·’as·sêp̄ lə·ḵāl ham·ma·ḥă·nōṯ lə·ṣiḇ·’ō·ṯām wə·‘al- ṣə·ḇā·’ōw ’ă·ḥî·‘e·zer ben- ‘am·mî·šad·dāy
verses.literal: Finally, the divisions of the camp of Dan . . . set out under their standard serving as the rear guard for all units with Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai in command . . .
verses.literalPt: Então partiu a bandeira do arraial dos filhos de Dã, fechando todos os arraiais segundo os seus exércitos; e sobre o seu exército estava Aieser, filho de Amisadai.

verses.original: וְעַל־ צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י אָשֵׁ֑ר פַּגְעִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ עָכְרָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- ṣə·ḇā maṭ·ṭêh bə·nê ’ā·šêr paḡ·‘î·’êl ben- ‘ā·ḵə·rān
verses.literal: Pagiel son of Ocran was over the division of the tribe of Asher . . .
verses.literalPt: E sobre o exército da tribo dos filhos de Aser, Pagiel, filho de Ocrã.

verses.original: וְעַ֨ל־ צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֑י אֲחִירַ֖ע בֶּן־ עֵינָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- ṣə·ḇā maṭ·ṭêh bə·nê nap̄·tā·lî ’ă·ḥî·ra‘ ben- ‘ê·nān
verses.literal: and Ahira son of Enan was over the division of the tribe of Naphtali . . .
verses.literalPt: E sobre o exército da tribo dos filhos de Naftali, Aira, filho de Enã.

verses.original: אֵ֛לֶּה מַסְעֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וַיִּסָּֽעוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh mas·‘ê ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl lə·ṣiḇ·’ō·ṯām way·yis·sā·‘ū
verses.literal: This was the order of march for the Israelite . . . divisions as they set out
verses.literalPt: Esta era a ordem das partidas dos filhos de Israel segundo os seus exércitos, quando partiam.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֗ה לְ֠חֹבָב בֶּן־ רְעוּאֵ֣ל הַמִּדְיָנִי֮ חֹתֵ֣ן מֹשֶׁה֒ נֹסְעִ֣ים׀ אֲנַ֗חְנוּ אֶל־ הַמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֹת֖וֹ אֶתֵּ֣ן לָכֶ֑ם לְכָ֤ה אִתָּ֙נוּ֙ וְהֵטַ֣בְנוּ לָ֔ךְ כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֥ה דִּבֶּר־ ט֖וֹב עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh lə·ḥō·ḇāḇ ben- rə·‘ū·’êl ham·miḏ·yā·nî ḥō·ṯên mō·šeh nō·sə·‘îm ’ă·naḥ·nū ’el- ham·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ō·ṯōw ’et·tên lā·ḵem lə·ḵāh ’it·tā·nū wə·hê·ṭaḇ·nū lāḵ kî- Yah·weh dib·ber- ṭō·wḇ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then Moses said to Hobab the son of Moses’ father-in-law Reuel the Midianite We are setting out for the place of which the LORD said I will give it to you Come with us and we will treat you well for the LORD has promised good things to Israel
verses.literalPt: Disse então Moisés a Hobabe, filho de Reuel, o midianita, sogro de Moisés: Nós caminhamos para aquele lugar, de que o SENHOR disse: Vo-lo darei; vai conosco e te faremos bem; porque o SENHOR falou bem sobre Israel.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖יו לֹ֣א אֵלֵ֑ךְ כִּ֧י אִם־ אֶל־ אַרְצִ֛י וְאֶל־ מוֹלַדְתִּ֖י אֵלֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw lō ’ê·lêḵ kî ’im- ’el- ’ar·ṣî wə·’el- mō·w·laḏ·tî ’ê·lêḵ
verses.literal: I will not go Hobab replied Instead . . . I am going back to my own land . . . and my own people
verses.literalPt: Porém ele lhe disse: Não irei; antes irei à minha terra e à minha parentela.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אַל־ נָ֖א תַּעֲזֹ֣ב אֹתָ֑נוּ כִּ֣י׀ עַל־ כֵּ֣ן יָדַ֗עְתָּ חֲנֹתֵ֙נוּ֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר וְהָיִ֥יתָ לָּ֖נוּ לְעֵינָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’al- nā ta·‘ă·zōḇ ’ō·ṯā·nū kî ‘al- kên yā·ḏa‘·tā ḥă·nō·ṯê·nū bam·miḏ·bār wə·hā·yî·ṯā lā·nū lə·‘ê·nā·yim
verses.literal: Please do not leave us Moses said since . . . . . . you know where we should camp in the wilderness and you can serve as our eyes
verses.literalPt: E ele disse: Ora, não nos deixes; porque tu sabes onde devemos acampar no deserto; nos servirás de guia.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֖ה כִּי־ תֵלֵ֣ךְ עִמָּ֑נוּ וְהָיָ֣ה׀ הַטּ֣וֹב הַה֗וּא אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֵיטִ֧יב יְהוָ֛ה עִמָּ֖נוּ וְהֵטַ֥בְנוּ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kî- ṯê·lêḵ ‘im·mā·nū wə·hā·yāh haṭ·ṭō·wḇ ha·hū ’ă·šer yê·ṭîḇ Yah·weh ‘im·mā·nū wə·hê·ṭaḇ·nū lāḵ
verses.literal: If you come with us we will share with you whatever . . . good things . . . the LORD gives us
verses.literalPt: E será que, vindo tu conosco, e sucedendo o bem que o SENHOR nos fizer, também nós te faremos bem.

verses.original: וַיִּסְעוּ֙ מֵהַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה דֶּ֖רֶךְ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים וַאֲר֨וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֜ה נֹסֵ֣עַ לִפְנֵיהֶ֗ם דֶּ֚רֶךְ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֔ים לָת֥וּר לָהֶ֖ם מְנוּחָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mê·har Yah·weh de·reḵ šə·lō·šeṯ yā·mîm wa·’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ- Yah·weh nō·sê·a‘ lip̄·nê·hem de·reḵ šə·lō·šeṯ yā·mîm lā·ṯūr lā·hem mə·nū·ḥāh
verses.literal: So they set out on a three-day . . . journey from the mountain of the LORD with the ark of the covenant of the LORD traveling ahead of them . . . for those three days to seek a resting place for them
verses.literalPt: Assim partiram do monte do SENHOR caminho de três dias; e a arca da aliança do SENHOR caminhou diante deles caminho de três dias, para lhes buscar lugar de descanso.

verses.original: וַעֲנַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם יוֹמָ֑ם בְּנָסְעָ֖ם מִן־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃׆ס
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·nan Yah·weh ‘ă·lê·hem yō·w·mām bə·nā·sə·‘ām min- ham·ma·ḥă·nɛ·hs
verses.literal: And the cloud of the LORD was over them by day when they set out from the camp
verses.literalPt: E a nuvem do SENHOR ia sobre eles de dia, quando partiam do arraial.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֛י בִּנְסֹ֥עַ הָאָרֹ֖ן וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֑ה קוּמָ֣ה׀ יְהוָ֗ה וְיָפֻ֙צוּ֙ אֹֽיְבֶ֔יךָ וְיָנֻ֥סוּ מְשַׂנְאֶ֖יךָ מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bin·sō·a‘ hā·’ā·rōn way·yō·mer mō·šeh qū·māh Yah·weh wə·yā·p̄u·ṣū ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā wə·yā·nu·sū mə·śan·’e·ḵā mip·pā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: Whenever the ark set out Moses would say Rise up O LORD May Your enemies be scattered may those who hate You flee before You
verses.literalPt: Acontecia que, partindo a arca, Moisés dizia: Levanta-te, SENHOR, e dissipados sejam os teus inimigos, e fujam diante de ti os odiadores.

verses.original: וּבְנֻחֹ֖ה יֹאמַ֑ר שׁוּבָ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה רִֽבְב֖וֹת אַלְפֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃׆ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nu·ḥōh yō·mar šū·ḇāh Yah·weh riḇ·ḇō·wṯ ’al·p̄ê yiś·rå̄·ʾē·ls
verses.literal: And when it came to rest he would say Return O LORD to the countless thousands of Israel
verses.literalPt: E, pousando ela, dizia: Volta, ó SENHOR, para os muitos milhares de Israel.
